description: Click on Detailed help to get your API Token from your nominal account. Connect to the API using your API token. 1) Create a text file that contains your API token. 2) Wire a string containing your API token directly. 3) For development, wire an empty string. When an empty string is wired, the API will look for a `.token` file in your application's directory. NOTE: Besure to exclude API Tokens (and token files) from source code control.

description:
Sets up backend buffers and analyzes the cluster structure.
This function does not send or capture data.
Performs datatype validation and buffer setup.

Cluster Element Requirements
Clusters must contain only the following data types:
- Signed Integers (I8, I16, I32, I64)
- Unsigned Integers (U8, U16, U32, U64)
- Singles (SGL)
- Doubles (DBL)
- Booleans
- Strings
- Nested Clusters
Nested clusters are supported and can contain any combination of the above data types.
The cluster and all elements must be named.

See `Streaming Cluster Data` example for useage notes.
